title: zeltnera madrensis
intro: Zeltnera madrensis, commonly known as Madrean Zeltnera or Madrean penstemon, is a species of flowering plant in the family Gentianaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, making it useful for treating various ailments such as wounds, infections, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Zeltnera madrensis involve its ability to stimulate digestion, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant properties, which contribute to its overall healing effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include iridoid glycosides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties, although further research is needed to fully understand its pharmacological effects.
